messages:
Priya: quick thought 1 1 1 111
Let's do an ugly-sweater photo wall + hot cocoa bar next Friday during lunch? :sunglasses: :mug_with_hot_chocolate:
Max: YES. photo wall idea = chef's kiss. can we have a tiny prize for most ridiculous sweater?
Ellen: love. prize = tiny rubber plant? or a Starbucks card? :thinking_face:
Chen: vote: rubber plant is adorable and sustainable. also can someone kidnap a garland from storage?
Rosa: i'll bring fairy lights + a roll of tinsel. speaking of cocoa, options: classic hot cocoa, peppermint, and dairy-free almond cocoa. react with :one: :two: :three: or reply.
Priya: 1 & 3 please (classic + dairy-free)
Max: 2 for me (peppermint ftw)
Ellen: 1. also sticky note for prize question: please no voting via DMs, let's do a tiny poll after lunch so the whole office sees.
Chen: i can make a google form in 10 min for sweater entries and prize voting.
Rosa: added: marshmallows and cinnamon sticks on my list. also can we put a small sign: "Please don't touch others' sweaters" 39;
IT-bot: FYI — projector in Lobby is available Fri 12/22 11:30-13:00 if you want to show a slideshow (resource id: P-445).
Priya: projector could show a rotating 10-sec loop of submissions. yes please.
Max: gift for winner = $25 coffee card + tiny rubber plant? split prize?
Ellen: split prize sounds cute. put me down for the coffee card.
Chen: i'll donate the rubber plant.
Rosa: ops-bot can you reserve the community table and add a note that it's a "Holiday Photo Wall + Cocoa" event?
ops-bot: Reservation confirmed 1 1 1 111 — Community Table reserved 12/22 11:30-13:00 (res id R-199240).
Max: meme time: https://tenor.com/view/ugly-sweater-cat-gif-12345 :joy_cat:
Priya: kudos to Rosa for decorations and Chen for the form! :raised_hands:
Ellen: RSVP here: yes w/ plus one? (i'll bring a friend who lives nearby)
Priya: totally fine. just add "plus one" in the form Chen posts.
Chen: form posted: https://forms.gle/holiday-sweater-199240 — add name, size for sweater photo placement, cocoa prefs, and if you're entering the contest.
Rosa: also will someone volunteer to be the official photo-taker? phone ok.
Max: i'll take photos. will bring my tripod.
IT-bot: Reminder: Free wifi guest passes available near Reception for any visitors.
Priya: perfect. i'll make a tiny slack reminder day-before. thanks everyone :sparkles:
Ellen: minor ask — can we make sure the veggie folks get a non-sugary cocoa option? maybe tea?
Rosa: will bring a couple of tea bags (peppermint + earl grey).
Max: RSVP: yes, bringing tripod and goofy sweater.
Chen: RSVP: yes, form is up.
Priya: last note — if you can't make it but want to submit a sweater photo, DM me or upload to the form. we'll include remote folks in voting.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled 1 1 1 111 for #random: 12/21 10:00 about "Holiday Photo Wall + Cocoa".
Priya: thread locked until day before unless someone needs to update details. :ok_hand:
